Two hundred feet beneath the ocean, deep-sea welder Maya patched a submarine hull. Sparks flared in the dark. Suddenly, a neon note pressed against the glass from inside: *“Do you always dance with fire?”*

Maya looked up into the eyes of a smiling biologist holding a marker. She tapped her helmet, indicating her radio was dead. He grinned, writing: *“Coffee on dry land?”*

Maya traced a heart on the glass.

Come back for the next part tomorrow.
